parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value on your client for this parameter. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot be more than 64 characters long.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the return value. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese.

- en: English.

Default value: en

parameters.name: UserClientIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the client.

parameters.name: Vpcs
parameters.description:
The list of VPCs.

> If you leave this parameter empty, all VPCs are unbound from the zone.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the zone.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun pvtz bind-zone-vpc --lang en --zone-id 34d4031b63c527358b710a61346a0000 --user-client-ip 127.0.XX.XX --vpcs VpcType=STANDARD VpcId=vpc-f8zvrvr1payllgz380000 RegionId=cn-hangzhou --client-token 6447728c8578e66aacf062d2df4446dc --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun pvtz BindZoneVpc --region cn-hangzhou --ZoneId 34d4031b63c527358b710a61346a0000 --Vpcs.1.VpcType STANDARD --Vpcs.1.VpcId 'vpc-f8zvrvr1payllgz380000' --UserClientIp '127.0.XX.XX' --Lang en --ClientToken 6447728c8578e66aacf062d2df4446dc --Vpcs.1.RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
